265-2073-2099--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
265-2073-2099--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Sarcatog. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-2466-3249--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-2466-3249--206.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2374-2841-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-1477-3581-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-3581-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-7741.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-7741.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1494-4444-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-997-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-997-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3967-7084-7422.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1061-4068-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4068-4603.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
You control at least one Mountain.
1061-4068-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

539-5411-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

225-565-1987-6991.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-6991.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Donnie & April and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Donnie & April.
When the land and Donnie & April enter the battlefield, Donnie & April and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-6991.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

969-1170-1329-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

475-1274-4186-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-4186-4321.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2100-4146.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Murmuring Mystic trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Murmuring Mystic trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

1115-1563-2457-6753.description:

Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

478-539-850--111.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat.

238-4050-5756.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding one mana of any color.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Havi, adding one mana of any color.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

440-1339-2034-2428.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-2428.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Horizon Chimera trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-5223-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-5223-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1247-1355-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two enchantments.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Sanctum Weaver and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1355-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

997-1429-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1429-5958.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

513-2364--47.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C}{C} from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1170-1328-2105-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-3480.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

3451-4191-4784-5231.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Augusta, adding {R}.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2108-5020-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
1636-2108-5020-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Peace Strider.
When Peace Strider dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Peace Strider on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Peace Strider from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Peace Strider enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Peace Strider trigger, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

2430-2950-3415-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Aven Surveyor.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Aven Surveyor and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Aven Surveyor from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Aven Surveyor enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Aven Surveyor.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-1770-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

427-913-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-913-4222.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1621-2034-4812-4871-5006.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a card using Lurrus this turn.
1621-2034-4812-4871-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wispweaver Angel, adding {C}{C}.
When Wispweaver Angel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Animate Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters the battlefield, it returns Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Repeat.

1494-2334-2744-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Soulherder triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
The Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade four times.
Resolve all Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
